title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search

paragraphs.en: Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce Globe , an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 为生成式搜索优化产品列表，语言智能体不仅需要高效地改写内容，还必须通过在不同类别中保留成功策略来实现持续自我改进。 然而，现有方法通常将结构化列表视为自由格式文本，导致有效策略隐含在提示词、搜索路径或改写结果中，而非积累为可重复使用的智能体记忆。 为解决这一局限性，我们提出了 Globe——一个智能体框架，它通过将优化知识存储于一个不断演进的、包含明确且按领域划分的行为指南中，驱动持续自我改进。 在每个周期中，编辑会应用相关行为并获得基于排名的反馈，随后由反思模块将这些反馈转化为行为更新。 对于在真实场景中的可靠执行而言，协调模块会移除冗余提案，策展模块会提交已接受的变化，而持续产生负面效果的行为则会被停用。 这一循环将周期性的反馈转化为持久且按领域划分的优化记忆。 实验表明，结构化行为优于单一提示词优化方法，而反馈驱动的智能体演进与协调机制进一步提升了有效性并降低了潜在风险。 这些学习到的行为在未见过的新产品类别中依然有效，说明智能体记忆的演化支持了可解释且可迁移的产品优化。

paragraphs.en: Language agents increasingly improve themselves not by updating weights, but by accumulating experience in an external memory that is continually refined through feedback ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . Building on these advances, agent-centric frameworks are expanding into e-commerce, as large language models (LLMs) shift search toward generative engines that directly compare and rank products by reasoning over rich textual contexts ( Li et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2023 ; Hou et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025b ) . In this environment, an agent optimizing a product listing must shift from conventional search engine optimization methods ( Davis, 2006 ; Gudivada et al., 2015 ) to strategic content structuring, as its success heavily depends on how favorably the downstream generative engine interprets the presented information.

paragraphs.en: A key challenge in this real-world setting lies in the structured nature of e-commerce product data. Product listings are not arbitrary free-form documents but consist of distinct fields, such as titles, feature bullets, and descriptions, each serving a different functional role. Nevertheless, prior methods commonly optimize a listing through a single prompt that rewrites the document as a whole ( Bagga et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) . This monolithic approach lacks structural boundaries, treating optimization as unstructured text generation. As illustrated in Figure 1 , relying on generic prompt optimization leads to critical structural errors, because the agent cannot restrict specific editing operations to their appropriate target fields.
paragraphs.zh: 在这种真实世界环境中，一个关键挑战在于电子商务产品数据的结构化特性。 产品列表并非任意的自由格式文档，而是由不同的字段组成，例如标题、功能要点和描述，每个字段都承担着不同的功能角色。 然而，以往的方法通常通过单个提示来优化产品列表，该提示会重写整个文档（Bagga et al., 2025；Yuan et al., 2026）。 这种整体化的方法缺乏结构边界，将优化过程视为非结构化的文本生成。 如图 1 所示，依赖通用提示优化会导致关键的结构错误，因为智能体无法将特定的编辑操作限制在相应的目标字段中。

paragraphs.en: Beyond this lack of structural control, current approaches fail to generalize successful strategies across multiple optimization episodes. Even if a specific rewrite tactic successfully improves a product’s rank in one category, monolithic prompt optimization cannot abstract this success into a reusable principle. As further demonstrated in Figure 1 , when a generic prompt attempts to transfer a durability strategy to new categories, it fails to adapt the context, forcing overfitted keywords (e.g., applying "rubber insulation" to leather boots) rather than grounding the edit in existing product facts. Consequently, effective strategies must be repeatedly rediscovered, making optimization dependent on fragmented and costly trial and error. Product optimization therefore requires an explicit agentic memory mechanism that transforms transient ranking outcomes into persistent, generalizable editing knowledge ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 除了缺乏结构性控制之外，现有方法还无法将成功的策略推广到多个优化周期中。 即使某种特定的重写策略成功提升了产品在某一类别中的排名，单一化的提示词优化也无法将这种成功抽象为可重复使用的原则。 如图 1 进一步所示，当通用提示词试图将耐用性策略迁移到新类别时，它无法适应上下文，导致过度拟合的关键词被强行使用（例如，将“橡胶绝缘”应用于皮靴），而非基于现有产品事实进行编辑。 因此，有效的策略必须被反复重新发现，这使得优化依赖于零散且代价高昂的试错过程。 因此，产品优化需要一个明确的智能体记忆机制，能够将短暂的排名结果转化为持久且可泛化的编辑知识（Shinn et al., 2023; Zhao et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we introduce GLOBE ( G enera L izable O ptimization B ehavior E volution), an agentic framework that represents product optimization knowledge as a structured behavior handbook. Rather than relying on a single unconstrained rewrite instruction, Globe decomposes optimization into explicit and reusable editing behaviors . Each behavior specifies a concrete editing operation, the listing fields in which the operation may be applied, and metadata summarizing its historical ranking outcomes. For example, a behavior may instruct the agent to specify the material of a likely wear point, strictly limiting this addition to the feature field. This formulation separates what should be changed from where the change is permitted, providing a more interpretable and structurally bounded interface for product-listing optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 GLOBE（G enera L izable O ptimization B ehavior E volution），这是一种智能体框架，它将产品优化知识表示为结构化的行为手册。 Globe 不依赖单一的无约束重写指令，而是将优化过程分解为明确且可重用的编辑行为。 每种行为都指定了具体的编辑操作、该操作可应用的列表字段，以及总结其历史排名结果的元数据。 例如，某种行为可能指示智能体指定某个潜在磨损点的材料，并严格将此添加操作限制在特征字段中。 这种设计将“应改变什么”与“允许在何处更改”分离开来，为产品列表优化提供了更具可解释性和结构约束的接口。

paragraphs.en: Globe further transforms transient ranking feedback into persistent optimization knowledge through an iterative deployment-and-evolution cycle. The current handbook is repeatedly applied to batches of query-product pairs, producing episode-level feedback from the resulting rank changes. Recurring success and failure patterns are then used to refine the handbook, after which the updated behaviors are redeployed in subsequent batches. By repeatedly alternating between handbook deployment and feedback-driven refinement, Globe converts episode-specific ranking outcomes into persistent and reusable optimization knowledge.

paragraphs.en: This formulation provides two complementary advantages. First, field-scoped behaviors explicitly specify both the editing operation and the product fields in which it may be applied, making individual strategies more structured and inspectable. Second, the evolving handbook preserves and reuses knowledge acquired from past ranking episodes rather than discarding it after each rewrite. We therefore investigate whether field-scoped behavior representations improve ranking effectiveness, whether feedback-driven handbook evolution reduces harmful outcomes, and whether the learned optimization knowledge transfers to unseen product categories.

paragraphs.en: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) aims to improve the visibility of target items in generative search by modifying their textual representations. Initial approaches showed that strategically injected text sequences can influence item exposure and output rankings ( Kumar and Lakkaraju, 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) . Subsequent prompt-based methods formulate GEO as document rewriting, using LLMs to modify content according to the inferred preferences of a target generative engine ( Bagga et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Recent agentic frameworks further automate this process by iteratively searching for effective document-modification strategies ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Despite this progression, existing approaches largely optimize documents through free-form, document-level generation, offering limited control over individual fields of structured product listings. Moreover, effective strategies typically remain embedded in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than being retained as explicit and reusable knowledge.

sents.en: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) aims to improve the visibility of target items in generative search by modifying their textual representations.
sents.zh: 生成式引擎优化（GEO）旨在通过修改目标项目的文本表示，提升其在生成式搜索中的可见性。

sents.en: Initial approaches showed that strategically injected text sequences can influence item exposure and output rankings ( Kumar and Lakkaraju, 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 早期方法表明，策略性地注入的文本序列可以影响项目的曝光度和输出排名（Kumar 和 Lakkaraju，2024；Jin 等，2026）。

sents.en: Subsequent prompt-based methods formulate GEO as document rewriting, using LLMs to modify content according to the inferred preferences of a target generative engine ( Bagga et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 随后的提示 기반 方法将 GEO 视为文档重写问题，利用大语言模型根据目标生成式引擎推断出的偏好修改内容（Bagga 等，2025；Wu 等，2025）。

sents.en: Recent agentic frameworks further automate this process by iteratively searching for effective document-modification strategies ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 近期的智能体框架进一步通过迭代搜索有效的文档修改策略，实现了这一过程的自动化（Yuan 等，2026）。

sents.en: Despite this progression, existing approaches largely optimize documents through free-form, document-level generation, offering limited control over individual fields of structured product listings.
sents.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，现有方法主要通过自由形式的文档级生成来优化文档，对结构化产品列表中的单个字段控制有限。

sents.en: Moreover, effective strategies typically remain embedded in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than being retained as explicit and reusable knowledge.
sents.zh: 此外，有效策略通常仍嵌入在提示、搜索路径或重写后的输出中，而非以明确且可重用的知识形式保留下来。

paragraphs.en: Effective optimization requires systems to not only generate high-quality outputs but also learn from past successes and failures to avoid repeatedly rediscovering the same strategies. Driven by this need, a growing line of research studies how feedback can be transformed from a transient correction signal into reusable knowledge ( Kim et al., 2025a ) . Early self-refinement methods use self- or peer-generated critiques to revise the current output ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2022 ) . Cross-episode approaches go beyond local revision by abstracting successful and failed trajectories into reusable reflections or lessons ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . At the system level, automatic prompt optimizers use natural-language critiques, textual feedback, or trajectory-level reflection to revise the instructions governing future executions ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . Recent memory-centric systems further externalize such abstractions into persistent handbooks, evolving playbooks, or learned memory architectures ( Didolkar et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ) . Together, these works demonstrate a progression from local output correction to persistent knowledge evolution, but largely focus on open-ended reasoning, coding, or planning. In contrast, structured product optimization requires reusable knowledge to be field-scoped and learned from indirect, relative ranking feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 有效的优化要求系统不仅能生成高质量的输出，还能从过去的成功与失败中学习，以避免重复发现相同的策略。 受此需求驱动，越来越多的研究开始探索如何将反馈从短暂的纠正信号转化为可复用的知识（Kim et al., 2025a）。 早期的自我完善方法利用自身或同伴生成的批评来修订当前输出（Madaan et al., 2023；Schick et al., 2022）。 跨回合方法超越了局部修订，通过将成功与失败的轨迹抽象为可复用的反思或经验教训来实现（Shinn et al., 2023；Zhao et al., 2024）。 在系统层面，自动提示优化器利用自然语言批评、文本反馈或轨迹层面的反思来修订指导未来执行的操作指令（Pryzant et al., 2023；Yuksekgonul et al., 2024；Agrawal et al., 2026）。 近期的记忆中心系统进一步将此类抽象知识外化为持久化的手册、动态演进的策略指南或学习到的记忆架构（Didolkar et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025；Xiong et al., 2026）。 这些研究共同展示了从局部输出纠正到持久化知识演进的演进过程，但主要聚焦于开放式的推理、编码或规划任务。 相比之下，结构化产品优化要求可复用的知识具有领域特异性，并且需通过间接的相对排名反馈进行学习。

paragraphs.en: Globe maintains a structured agentic memory of reusable product-optimization behaviors through an iterative deployment-and-evolution cycle, illustrated in Figure 2 . paragraphs.en: A behavior is a reusable, field-scoped editing strategy for product listings. Each behavior stores an identifier, a name, an editing instruction, permitted target fields, conflicting behaviors, and feedback metadata . The instruction defines a concrete editing operation, such as making the product type explicit or foregrounding a query-relevant specification. The target-field set specifies where the operation may be applied, with targets ⁡ ( b ) ⊆ { title , features , description } \mathrm{targets}(b)\subseteq\{\mathrm{title},\mathrm{features},\mathrm{description}\} . The conflicts field records behaviors that should not be applied together. Rather than strictly filtering these rules, this field serves as a soft constraint that instructs the editor to avoid applying conflicting behaviors simultaneously. Finally, the feedback metadata tracks the number of helpful, harmful, and neutral outcomes associated with behavior b b , denoted by h + ​ ( b ) h^{+}(b) , h − ​ ( b ) h^{-}(b) , and h 0 ​ ( b ) h^{0}(b) , respectively. We summarize the empirical utility of each behavior using the score s ⁡ ( b ) = h + ​ ( b ) − h − ​ ( b ) s(b)=h^{+}(b)-h^{-}(b) . Let n ⁡ ( b ) = h + ​ ( b ) + h − ​ ( b ) + h 0 ​ ( b ) n(b)=h^{+}(b)+h^{-}(b)+h^{0}(b) denote the number of episodes in which the behavior has been applied. paragraphs.en: At iteration n n , the active behavior set ℋ n act \mathcal{H}^{\mathrm{act}}_{n} is deployed across a batch of K K query-product pairs. For each episode ( q i , p i ) (q_{i},p_{i}) , the LLM editor receives the user query, the original structured product listing, and the complete active behavior set as a strategy pool. The editor selects the behaviors relevant to the current query-product context and generates a rewritten target product p i ′ p^{\prime}_{i} . Each selected behavior may be applied only to the listing fields specified by its target-field scope. The editor is also instructed to preserve the original section structure and leave fields outside the permitted scopes unchanged. paragraphs.en: The Reflector analyzes recent episode logs together with the current handbook to identify recurring success and failure patterns. Rather than rewriting the handbook as unrestricted text, it proposes structured delta operations that either add a new behavior or modify an existing one. An Add operation is proposed when the observed pattern is not adequately covered by the current handbook. A Modify operation refines an existing behavior by clarifying its instruction, application condition, or permitted target fields. The Reflector does not directly delete behaviors, since behaviors associated with consistently harmful outcomes are excluded through the active-status criterion while remaining stored for traceability.
paragraphs.zh: 反射器通过分析近期的执行日志并结合当前手册，识别出重复出现的成功与失败模式。 它不会将手册改写为无限制的自由文本，而是提出结构化的增量操作，用于添加新行为或修改现有行为。 当观察到的模式无法被当前手册充分涵盖时，系统会提出一个“添加”操作。 “修改”操作通过明确行为的指令、适用条件或允许的目标字段，对现有行为进行优化。 反射器不会直接删除行为，因为与持续有害结果相关的行为会通过活跃状态标准被排除，但为保留追溯性，这些行为仍会被存储。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Globe against the following configurations. 1 1 1 Recent self-evolving agents are not directly applicable as our baselines because they are fundamentally designed for free-form document optimization, rendering field-scoped constraints incompatible with their core exploration mechanism. Prompt Opt. applies a single monolithic rewriting instruction following the prompt-based E-GEO setting ( Bagga et al., 2025 ) . Static HB utilizes a fixed, non-evolving handbook of 9 generic rewrite rules ( Aggarwal et al., 2023 ) . paragraphs.en: We evaluate system performance using four metrics. Mean Rank Gain (MRG) and Success Rate (SR) measure the average position improvement and the frequency of successful optimizations, respectively. To evaluate stability, we evaluate Downside Risk (DSR) , which applies a quadratic penalty to rank degradations to capture the severity of harmful rewrites. paragraphs.zh: 我们使用四个指标来评估系统性能。 平均排名增益（MRG）和成功率（SR）分别衡量平均排名提升程度以及优化成功的频率。 为评估稳定性，我们计算了下行风险（DSR），该指标对排名下降施加二次惩罚，以反映有害重写行为的严重程度。 最后，类别方差（CV）衡量 MRG 在六个类别中的方差，分数越低表示性能越具有普适性。 更多细节见附录 B.2。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed handbook framework, we examine the contribution of its core design components to the overall performance of Globe . As shown in Table 1 , the Static HB already achieves a substantial improvement over monolithic prompt optimization in both ranking effectiveness and downside risk. Because this baseline uses only the initial generic behaviors without feedback-based updates, its improvement suggests that decomposing optimization knowledge into explicit operations, together with field scoping, provides a stronger foundation than the evaluated monolithic prompt baseline. This result further shows that structured behavior representation contributes substantially to Globe ’s performance even before feedback-driven evolution is introduced.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们提出的手册框架的有效性，我们考察了其核心设计组件对 Globe 整体性能的贡献。 如表 1 所示，静态 HB 在排名有效性和负面风险方面已经比单体提示优化实现了显著提升。 由于该基线仅使用初始的通用行为，而没有基于反馈的更新，其改进表明：将优化知识分解为显式操作，并结合领域范围限定，比所评估的单体提示基线提供了更坚实的基础。 这一结果进一步表明，即使尚未引入反馈驱动的演化机制，结构化的行为表示也已对 Globe 的性能做出了重要贡献。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-based evolution further improves MRG and SR by extending the handbook beyond its initial generic heuristics. However, the unmoderated variant also produces a larger handbook and higher category variance, suggesting that unrestricted accumulation may introduce redundant or narrowly specialized behaviors. The increase in handbook capacity also means that its improvement cannot be attributed entirely to feedback-based learning. Evolution expands the available optimization knowledge, but accumulating more behaviors does not necessarily produce a more consistent handbook.
paragraphs.zh: 基于反馈的演化通过把手册的范围扩展到其最初的通用启发式方法之外，进一步提升了 MRG 和 SR。 然而，未经调控的版本也会产生更大的手册和更高的类别方差，这表明不受限制的积累可能会引入冗余或高度特化的行为。 手册容量的增加也意味着其改进不能完全归因于基于反馈的学习。 演化扩展了可用的优化知识，但积累更多行为并不必然能产生更一致的手册。

paragraphs.en: The full Globe addresses this limitation by filtering semantically redundant and functionally overlapping proposals before they are committed. Despite retaining fewer behaviors than the unmoderated variant, it achieves stronger overall performance together with lower DSR and CV. This pattern suggests that the Moderator acts as handbook-level regularization, improving the composition of the accumulated knowledge rather than simply expanding its size. Overall, moderated evolution produces a more compact handbook with a better balance between ranking effectiveness and consistency.

paragraphs.en: To examine whether iterative handbook evolution produces sustained improvements beyond the final aggregate results, we trace ranking performance as the number of training examples increases.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究手册的迭代演化是否在最终汇总结果之外还能带来持续改进，我们追踪了训练样本数量增加时的排名表现。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 3 , MRG improves rapidly in the early stages of training, as feedback from the initial batches reveals optimization patterns not covered by the seed handbook, and then plateaus as additional batches are processed. This trajectory indicates that feedback-based evolution progressively enriches the handbook, but its benefits exhibit diminishing returns once broadly useful behaviors have been acquired. DSR also declines overall, though not monotonically, indicating that evolution gradually mitigates harmful ranking outcomes. Together, these patterns suggest that once frequently occurring optimization patterns have been observed, further improvement depends less on training-set size than on broader coverage of query intents and product contexts that provide genuinely new feedback .
paragraphs.zh: 如图3所示，MRG在训练初期迅速提升，因为初始批次提供的反馈揭示了种子手册未涵盖的优化模式；随着更多批次的处理，其提升随后进入平台期。 这一趋势表明，基于反馈的演化过程会逐步丰富手册内容，但一旦广泛适用的行为被掌握后，其带来的收益便会呈现边际递减效应。 DSR整体上也出现下降，尽管并非单调递减，这表明演化过程逐渐缓解了有害的排名结果。 综合来看，这些模式显示：一旦频繁出现的优化模式被观察到，进一步的提升便不再主要依赖训练集规模，而是更取决于对查询意图和产品语境的广泛覆盖，从而获得真正全新的反馈。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, to test whether refinement improves the specific behaviors it targets, rather than merely coinciding with handbook growth, we compare each modified behavior’s episode-level outcomes before and after modification (Appendix C ). In contrast, modifying behaviors that were already performing above average yields no measurable gain. These results suggest that modify operations act as targeted repairs for under-performing behaviors rather than as indiscriminate handbook expansion.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，为了检验优化是否真正改进了其针对的具体行为，而不仅仅是与手册的增长同步，我们比较了每个被修改的行为在修改前后于单轮任务中的结果（附录 C）。 在被修改的九种表现不佳的行为中，有八种的表现优于一个匹配的均值回归对照组（符号检验，p = 0.020），其帮助率平均提升了 5.3 个百分点。 相比之下，修改原本表现就已高于平均水平的行为，并未带来任何可测量的提升。 这些结果表明，修改操作更像是针对表现不佳行为的定向修复，而非无差别地扩展手册内容。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether the evolved handbook captures transferable optimization knowledge rather than category-specific heuristics, we conduct a leave-one-category-out (LOCO) evaluation. Specifically, for each macro-category, we evolve a separate handbook using only the training queries from the remaining five categories. Figure 4 compares the MRG improvement over the seed handbook for the LOCO models and the fully trained Globe model. The result confirms that the benefits of feedback-driven evolution are not strictly bound to domain-specific exposure. The LOCO handbook consistently retains a substantial portion of the aggregate improvements seen in the fully trained model. Furthermore, the LOCO approach even surpasses full training in some categories. These category-level differences suggest that training on all categories can occasionally hurt a specific category through cross-category interference, which we leave for future analysis. Nevertheless, they show that in-category exposure is not a strict prerequisite for generating effective rewrites. Together with the modest overall MRG decrease of 0.07, these results suggest that feedback-driven evolution extracts transferable optimization strategies that remain effective without target-category exposure, avoiding category-specific memorization.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验演化出的手册是否捕捉到了可迁移的优化知识，而非特定类别的经验法则，我们进行了“留一类别”（LOCO）评估。 具体而言，对于每个宏观类别，我们仅使用其余五个类别的训练查询来演化一个独立的手册。 图4比较了LOCO模型和完全训练的Globe模型在MRG方面相对于初始手册的提升情况。 结果证实，反馈驱动演化的优势并非严格依赖于特定领域的接触经验。 LOCO手册始终保留了完全训练模型中观察到的总体改进的相当一部分。 此外，在某些类别中，LOCO方法甚至超越了完整训练的效果。 这些类别层面的差异表明，在所有类别上进行训练有时可能会通过跨类别干扰而损害特定类别的表现，这一问题我们留待未来分析。 尽管如此，这些结果仍显示，类别内部的接触经验并非生成有效改写内容的绝对前提条件。 结合MRG总体仅下降了0.07这一温和的变化，这些结果表明，反馈驱动演化能够提取出可迁移的优化策略，这些策略在没有目标类别接触经验的情况下依然有效，从而避免了特定类别的记忆化。

sents.en: Furthermore, the LOCO approach even surpasses full training in some categories.
sents.zh: 此外，在某些类别中，LOCO方法甚至超越了完整训练的效果。

paragraphs.en: To determine whether the observed rank gains stem from transferable optimization rather than a generative engine simply favoring its own outputs, we freeze the GPT-5.4 editor and the handbook it produced. We then replace the ranking model with two different engines: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B and Gemini-3.5-flash 4 4 4 https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.5-flash . Although all rankers operate on the same ten-position rank scale, they differ in baseline orderings, calibration, and ranking stability. We therefore emphasize within-ranker comparisons between methods rather than interpreting absolute differences across rankers as model-quality differences. As shown in Table 2 , the best and worst methods are unchanged across all three rankers. paragraphs.en: We introduced Globe , a framework that maintains product-optimization knowledge as explicit, field-scoped behaviors in an evolving handbook. By converting ranking feedback into persistent and reusable editing knowledge, Globe enables effective and interpretable optimization while transferring to unseen product categories. More broadly, our findings suggest that evolving structured behaviors offers a practical path toward interpretable and transferable agentic memory for generative search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Globe，一个将产品优化知识以显式、领域特定的行为形式存储在不断更新的手册中的框架。 通过将排名反馈转化为持久且可重用的编辑知识，Globe 实现了有效且可解释的优化，同时能够迁移到未见过的产品类别中。 更广泛地说，我们的研究结果表明，不断演进的结构化行为为生成式搜索提供了实现可解释且可迁移的智能体记忆的实际路径。

paragraphs.en: A key limitation is that the editor, ranker, Reflector, and Moderator are all instantiated from the same model (GPT-5.4). Because the ranker that provides the reward signal shares a model family with the components optimized against it, the learned behaviors may partly capture ranker-specific preferences rather than ranker-agnostic optimization knowledge. We probe this with a cross-ranker evaluation in Section 4.5 ; fully disentangling transferable knowledge from ranker-specific artifacts remains future work. In addition, credit assignment over behaviors is approximate. Since each episode yields a single rank change for the entire rewrite, the episode’s directional outcome is attributed to all applied behaviors rather than to each behavior’s individual contribution (Section 3.3 ). A useful behavior can thus absorb harmful counts from co-applied behaviors. These counts also rely on the editor’s self-reported list of applied behaviors, which is not verified against the actual edits; an audit of 50 training episodes judged by a separate LLM (Claude Opus 5) found 88.3% of reported behaviors consistent with the edits made and few applied behaviors left unreported. Batch-level aggregation and the probation period mitigate this attribution noise but do not eliminate it. More precise attribution, such as per-behavior counterfactual rewrites, would incur substantially higher ranking costs per episode, and we leave its efficient integration into the evolution loop to future work. Moreover, because modified behaviors inherit their accumulated feedback counts, the active-status criterion reacts slowly to a harmful modify , and Globe currently has no mechanism to revert such a revision. Beyond these signal-level limitations, while establishing a rigorous performance ceiling with high-end models necessitates substantial computational overhead during the multi-agent learning phase, our inference stage remains highly efficient; the compiled handbook acts as a static set of rules that applies verified behaviors in a single pass without iterative optimization loops. Furthermore, distilling these structured behaviors into smaller, open-source models via fine-tuning represents a promising direction to drastically reduce future deployment costs. Finally, as real-world e-commerce search algorithms are dynamic and continuously updated, accumulated editing behaviors may experience temporal degradation and require periodic re-evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 一个关键限制是，编辑器、排序器、反射器和调节器都实例化自同一模型（GPT-5.4）。 由于提供奖励信号的排序器与针对其进行优化的组件共享同一模型家族，因此学习到的行为可能部分地捕捉了排序器特定的偏好，而非与排序器无关的优化知识。 我们在第 4.5 节通过跨排序器评估对此进行了探究；完全区分可迁移知识与排序器特定的残留特征仍是未来的工作。 此外，对行为的功劳分配是近似的。 由于每个回合仅对整个重写产生一次排名变化，因此该回合的方向性结果被归因于所有应用的行为，而非每个行为的个体贡献（第 3.3 节）。 因此，一个有用的行为可能会吸收同时应用的行为所带来的有害计数。 这些计数还依赖于编辑器自行报告的应用行为列表，而该列表并未与实际编辑进行验证；由独立 LLM（Claude Opus 5）评估的 50 个训练回合的审计发现，88.3% 的报告行为与所做的编辑一致，且仅有少数应用行为未被报告。 批量级聚合和试用期可以减轻这种归因噪声，但无法完全消除它。 更精确的归因方法，例如按行为进行反事实重写，将导致每个回合的排名成本显著增加，因此我们将其高效整合到演化循环中的工作留待未来完成。 此外，由于修改后的行为会继承其累积的反馈计数，因此活跃状态标准对有害的修改反应缓慢，并且 Globe 目前没有任何机制可以撤销此类修订。 除了这些信号层面的限制之外，尽管使用高端模型建立严格性能上限需要在多智能体学习阶段投入大量计算资源，但我们的推理阶段仍然非常高效；编译后的手册充当静态规则集，在一次通过中应用已验证的行为，而无需迭代优化循环。 此外，通过微调将这些结构化行为蒸馏到更小、开源的模型中，是一个有前景的方向，可以大幅降低未来的部署成本。 最后，由于现实世界中的电子商务搜索算法是动态且持续更新的，累积的编辑行为可能会随时间退化，并需要定期重新演化。

paragraphs.en: Methods for improving product visibility in generative search may be used to unfairly influence rankings, and rank improvement should not be interpreted as evidence of superior product quality. To reduce misleading edits, Globe includes a factual-grounding behavior that requires rewritten claims to remain supported by the original listing. Nevertheless, language models may still introduce unsupported implications or overstate product benefits. In practical deployments, rewritten listings should therefore be verified against the original listing and monitored for deceptive or exaggerated claims.
paragraphs.zh: 用于提升生成式搜索中产品可见性的方法可能会被用来不公平地影响排名，且排名提升不应被解读为产品品质更优的证据。 为了减少误导性编辑，Globe 引入了一种事实依据机制，要求改写后的主张仍需有原始列表内容作为支持。 尽管如此，语言模型仍可能引入缺乏依据的暗示或夸大产品优势。 因此，在实际部署中，应对改写后的列表与原始列表进行核对，并监测是否存在具有欺骗性或夸大的主张。

paragraphs.en: To assess backbone robustness, we evaluate Globe across multiple LLMs. For each backbone, we rerun the complete handbook-evolution procedure from the seed handbook, using that model for all LLM-based components and retaining the same data splits and hyperparameters. As shown in Table 4 , all configurations achieve positive rank gains, while exhibiting different trade-offs across MRG, SR, and DSR. paragraphs.zh: 为评估骨干模型的鲁棒性，我们在多种大型语言模型（LLM）上对 Globe 进行了评估。 对于每个骨干模型，我们都从种子手册开始重新运行完整的手册演化流程，使用该模型处理所有基于 LLM 的组件，并保留相同的数据划分和超参数设置。 如表 4 所示，所有配置都实现了正向的排名提升，但在 MRG、SR 和 DSR 方面表现出不同的权衡关系。 这些结果表明，Globe 在专有模型和开放权重模型中均保持有效，尽管其性能取决于所采用的底层骨干模型。

paragraphs.en: Every method optimizes the same target product in the same competitive context, and is scored against the same reference ranking. This shared setup is intended to isolate differences arising from the rewriting strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法都在相同的竞争背景下优化同一个目标产品，并依据相同的参考排名进行评分。 每个 E-GEO 查询（Bagga 等人，2025）都附带一个包含十个亚马逊商品列表的候选集，每个列表都被序列化为标题、特征和描述字段。 我们以均匀随机方式抽取一个候选项作为目标产品，仅存储一次其索引，并在 GLOBE、其消融实验以及所有基线方法中重复使用该索引；重写前的排名 r ℳ ​ ( q , 𝒫 , p t ) r_{\mathcal{M}}(q,\mathcal{P},p_{t}) 也同样只计算一次并缓存。 这种共享的设置旨在隔离由重写策略所产生的差异。

paragraphs.en: We use 1,000 queries for handbook construction, processed as ten batches of 100 pairs, and a disjoint set of 900 queries for evaluation. Category labels are not provided by the benchmark at the query level. We first use GPT-5.4-nano to construct a mapping table from the unique Amazon main category values in the dataset to the six macro-categories. This mapping table is applied deterministically to every candidate product. Each query is assigned the majority macro-category among the candidates in its product set. The evaluation set is built by sampling 150 queries per macro-category. An episode is discarded when the editor returns no usable rewrite or when the ranker’s output cannot be parsed into a complete permutation of the ten candidates after all retries; such failures are excluded rather than imputed, since scoring them as zero gain would reward methods that fail more often. This leaves 887 of the 900 episodes for GLOBE, with 146 to 149 episodes per category, and comparable counts for the baselines. GLOBE uses no validation set, as the handbook is updated directly from training-batch feedback; only the prompt-optimization baseline needs one, selecting its final prompt on 100 held-out validation queries evaluated after each epoch.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 1,000 条查询来构建手册，这些查询被处理为十个包含 100 对数据的批次，并保留一个由 900 条查询组成的独立集合用于评估。 基准测试在查询层面并未提供类别标签。 我们首先使用 GPT-5.4-nano 构建一个映射表，将数据集中亚马逊主类别的唯一值映射到六个宏观类别。 该映射表被确定性地应用于每一个候选产品。 每条查询都被分配其产品集合中所有候选项所对应的多数宏观类别。 评估集通过从每个宏观类别中采样 150 条查询来构建。 当编辑未返回任何可用的改写结果，或者在所有重试后排名器的输出仍无法解析为十个候选项的完整排列时，该轮次将被丢弃；此类失败会被排除而非进行插值，因为若将其评分为零增益，反而会奖励那些失败频率更高的方法。 这样 GLOBE 便保留了 900 轮次中的 887 轮，每个类别有 146 到 149 轮次，基线模型的数量也大致相当。 GLOBE 不使用验证集，因为手册是直接根据训练批次的反馈进行更新的；只有提示优化基线模型需要验证集，它会在每个周期结束后，使用 100 条预留的验证查询来评估并选择最终的提示。

paragraphs.en: All LLM components, Editor, Ranker, Reflector, and the functional-deduplication stage of the Moderator use the gpt-5.4-global Azure deployment (which corresponds to the standard, publicly available GPT-5.4 model), with temperature set per role: 0.5 0.5 for the Editor, 0.3 0.3 for the Ranker, 0.7 0.7 for the Reflector so that it explores diverse revisions, and 0.0 0.0 for the Moderator so that redundancy decisions are near-deterministic. Calls are capped at 5,000 completion tokens, retried up to five times, and issued with at most 30 concurrent requests. The editor receives the complete active behavior set as its strategy pool rather than a retrieved subset, and the handbook is frozen for the duration of a batch, so all 100 episodes of a batch run under one handbook version.

paragraphs.en: Table 5 lists the complete seed handbook ℋ 1 \mathcal{H}_{1} from which every GLOBE run starts. It contains nine behaviors adapted from the GEO strategies of Aggarwal et al. (2023) : their best-performing document-level strategies ( Statistics Addition , Cite Sources , Quotation Addition , Fluency Optimization , Easy-to-Understand , Authoritative , Technical Terms ), rewritten as field-scoped editing operations over structured product listings, plus two behaviors that are required by the e-commerce setting but have no counterpart in free-form GEO: B008 , which anchors the rewrite to the shopper’s query intent, and B009 , which constrains all assertions to evidence present in the original listing. The same nine behaviors constitute the Static HB baseline, which deploys them without any feedback-based update. All feedback counters h + , h − , h 0 h^{+},h^{-},h^{0} are zero-initialized, so every seed behavior enters the first batch inside the probation period.
paragraphs.zh: 表5列出了完整的初始手册 ℋ 1 \mathcal{H}_{1}，所有 GLOBE 运行都由此开始。该手册包含九种行为，这些行为改编自 Aggarwal 等人（2023）提出的 GEO 策略：他们表现最佳的文档级策略（添加统计数据、引用来源、添加引文、优化流畅性、易于理解、权威性和专业术语），这些策略被重新编写为针对结构化产品列表的字段级编辑操作；此外还包括两种电子商务场景所必需但在自由形式 GEO 中并无对应项的行为：B008，它将重写内容锚定在购物者的查询意图上；以及 B009，它将所有断言限制在原始列表中存在的证据范围内。这九种行为也构成了静态 HB 基线模型，该模型在不进行任何基于反馈的更新的情况下部署这些行为。所有反馈计数器 h + , h − , h 0 h^{+},h^{-},h^{0} 均初始化为零，因此每种初始行为都会在试用期内的第一批处理中启动。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether modify operations improve the specific behaviors they target, rather than the handbook improving only through the addition of new behaviors, we compare each modified behavior’s episode-level outcomes before and after its modification using the training logs of the final Globe run. For every behavior with at least one deployed modify , we split its applied episodes at the modification boundary and compute the helpful rate HR ⁡ ( b ) = h + ​ ( b ) / n ⁡ ( b ) \mathrm{HR}(b)=h^{+}(b)/n(b) and mean rank gain on each side (Table 6 ). Since overall performance also improves over training (Figure 3 ), we estimate the change expected from this shared trend and mean reversion using non-modified behaviors over the same windows, and subtract it from each observed change.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验修改操作是否真正提升了它们所针对的具体行为，而不仅仅是通过添加新行为来改善手册表现，我们利用最终 Globe 运行的训练日志，比较了每个被修改的行为在修改前后于单个回合中的结果。 对于每个至少部署了一次修改的行为，我们在其应用回合中按修改边界进行分割，并分别计算两侧的有益率 HR⁡(b)=h⁺(b)/n(b) 和平均排名提升（见表 6）。 由于整体性能在训练过程中也会提升（见图 3），我们通过分析相同时间窗口内未修改的行为，估算出这种共同趋势和均值回归所预期的变化量，并将其从每个观测到的变化中扣除。

paragraphs.en: The improvement concentrates on behaviors that were under-performing when modified. Behaviors that were under-performing when modified ( † in Table 6 ) consistently improve beyond their matched control (eight of nine; sign test p = 0.020 p=0.020 ), including B012, whose repair is traced qualitatively in Table 3 . In contrast, modifying behaviors already performing above average yields no consistent gain: five of the six stay within 3.1 percentage points in helpful rate, while B024 declines. B036 is the only under-performing behavior that does not improve. Both B024 and B036 were modified in the last update before the final training batch, so their post-modification outcomes rest on that batch alone, in which the pooled helpful rate also fell; B024’s revision also dropped its list of example settings, and in that batch the editor often applied it to queries with no adjustment need. Per-behavior significance is limited for behaviors with few post-modification episodes (e.g., B013, B018, B020), so the evidence rests primarily on the aggregate sign test rather than on individual behaviors. While these comparisons are observational and inherit the approximate per-behavior attribution (see Limitations), they indicate that modify operations are most effective as targeted repairs for under-performing behaviors, whereas revising behaviors that already perform well offers no clear benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 改进主要集中在那些在修改后表现不佳的行为上。 那些在修改后表现不佳的行为（表6中的†）持续优于其匹配的对照组（九项中有八项；符号检验 p = 0.020），包括 B012，其修复过程在表3中进行了定性追踪。 相比之下，修改原本表现高于平均水平的行为并未带来一致的提升：六项中有五项的帮助率变化未超过3.1个百分点，而 B024 的表现则下降。 B036 是唯一没有改进的低效行为。 B024 和 B036 都在最终训练批次之前的最后一次更新中被修改，因此它们修改后的结果仅取决于该批次，而该批次的综合帮助率也下降了；B024 的修订还减少了其示例设置列表，并且在该批次中，编辑经常将其应用于无需调整的问题。 对于修改后样本量较少的行为（例如 B013、B018、B020），逐行为的显著性有限，因此证据主要依赖于汇总的符号检验，而非单个行为的结果。 尽管这些比较属于观察性研究，并继承了近似的逐行为归因（参见“局限性”），但它们表明，“修改”操作作为针对低效行为的定向修复最为有效，而修订原本表现良好的行为则没有明显益处。

paragraphs.en: The behaviors fail in different ways. B014 is mismatched with the setting: it places a price or budget match up front, but E-GEO listings contain no price field, so the edit can rarely be grounded in the listing; it was applied only five times over seven batches, and six successive modify operations did not make it useful. B023 and B032 are misapplied: they describe reasonable edits, but the editor often applied them to queries in which attachment or style was secondary or absent, so placing that detail up front displaced the shopper’s main need. B046 was added late and deactivated after a single batch, in which it rarely changed the rank and was more often harmful than helpful.
paragraphs.zh: 这些行为以不同方式失效。 B014 与设置不匹配：它要求在前端设置价格或预算匹配，但 E-GEO 列表中没有价格字段，因此该编辑很少能基于列表内容执行；在七个批次中仅应用了五次，且连续六次修改操作也未能使其发挥作用。 B023 和 B032 被错误应用：它们描述了合理的编辑，但编辑者常常将它们应用于附件或样式次要或缺失的查询，因此将这一细节置于前端反而掩盖了购物者的主要需求。 B046 是较晚添加的，但在一个批次后就被停用；在该批次中，它很少改变排名，且更多时候有害无益。

paragraphs.en: Although the criterion uses only ranking outcomes, most of the behaviors it removes correspond to identifiable failure modes. Removing them keeps these behaviors out of the editor’s strategy pool in later batches and at test time, without manual inspection of the handbook. Because deactivated behaviors remain stored, they also document what did not work in this setting, such as B014’s price-based edits on listings without prices.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管该标准仅使用排名结果，但它移除的大多数行为都对应着可识别的故障模式。 移除这些行为后，在后续批次和测试阶段，这些行为将不会进入编辑器的策略池，而无需手动查阅手册进行检查。 由于被停用的行为仍被保留，它们也记录了这个设置中哪些方法并未奏效，例如 B014 对没有价格的商品列表进行的基于价格的修改。
